newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian electricity usage climbs 4pct in July.
newsitem.headline: Italian electricity usage climbs 4pct in July.

text.p: Italian electricity consumption rose four percent year-on-year in July, the fourth monthly rise in succession, utility company Enel said in a statement.

"After the decline in the first three months of the year, the positive turnaround in trend, that we have registered since April...is indicative of a stable recovery in electricity consumption," Enel chairman Chicco Testa said in the statement.
Electricity usage rose 6.4 percent in April, 2.7 percent in May and 2.7 percent in June.
